title: Voter records Travis County had to catch up on
subtitle: Batches its voter registrar has reported this fall, in records
alt: Bar chart of three batches of voter records Travis County's voter registrar has reported this fall, from KXAN: 32,000 registration records sent by the Texas Department of Public Safety, which the county finished updating about a week before October 17; 20,000 paper registration applications the registrar said were still being reviewed at that time; and 1,100 name and address updates from the Texas Secretary of State, received by October 17.
